anchor: Startup-only certificates remain at their declared boundary until a live-formula derivation is established.
addition: **Planned row-occupancy extension:** if certified absence literals `a_i` cover an exact partition of a row, introduce fresh `p` with `(p ∨ a_i)` for every block and `(¬p ∨ ¬a_1 ∨ ... ∨ ¬a_k)`. These RAT definitions give the unique extension `p = OR_i ¬a_i`; project `p` during model reconstruction. Reuse existing certified interval variables before adding helpers. Positive phase/priority on `p` is only a controller-owned branch choice: asserting `p` as a unit or claiming a row-cover deduction still requires its own proof. This planned conservative extension changes the Boolean search vocabulary, not the set of projected models.
